column1: # Parity bundles pinned per MCP platform version they were answered at:
# platform, bundle, sha256. The parity run compares the newest X.Y.Z line
# (parity.Newest); unsynced is the API's own recording, the regression lock.
# 2.5.23 and 2.5.24 were answered from producer commits made after those
# versions' tags (each named in its bundle's commit): records only, not
# parity evidence. 2.6.8, 2.6.12, 2.6.13 and 2.6.18 were answered at their tags' commits.
# 2.6.22 was answered at a producer commit on its tag that adds only the parity
# scripts (packages/*/scripts/parity-*.ts): the platform's code is the tag's.
# 2.5.23 is projected with viafrei.parity.rules/3: kept as that version's record,
# Load refuses it under rules/4 (lock_test.go). It is compared only by a
# 2.5.24 to 2.6.18 are projected with viafrei.parity.rules/4 and state no
